name: Vall Kumauri's flagship
description: Vall Kumauri's flagship was a starship used by the warlord Vall Kumauri. When Kumauri's conquests of approximately 10,000 BBY led to a conflict between his empire and the Galactic Republic, the flagship participated in a battle between the two factions. Both the battle and Kumauri's flagship were eventually depicted in a fresco in a Kumauri Empire palace on an Outer Rim Territories moon.
